Title 3—The President
Executive Order 12095 November 2,1978
Creating an Emergency Board To Investigate a Dispute Between Wien A ir A laska, Inc.
and Certain Individuals
A  dispute exists between Wien Air Alaska, Inc., and certain individuals  
represented by the Air Line Pilots Association, a labor organization.
Section 44 o f the Airline Deregulation Act o f 1978 (Public Law 95-504)  
directed that the provisions of Section 10 o f the Railway Labor Act, as  
amended, be invoked despite the fact that the National Mediation Board has  
failed to find that the dispute in its judgment substantially threatens to inter­
rupt interstate commerce to a degree such as to deprive a section o f the  
country o f essential transportation service.
N O W , THEREFORE, by the authority vested in me by Section 44 of the  
Airline Deregulation Act o f 1978 (Public Law 95-504) it is hereby ordered as  
follows:
1-101. Establishment o f  Board. There is established a board o f three mem­
bers to be appointed by the President to investigate this dispute. No member  
of the board shall be pecuniarily or otherwise interested in any organization of  
airline employees or any carrier.
1-102. Report. The board shall report its findings to the President with  
respect to the dispute within 30 days from the date o f this Order.

versions.research_rationale: This partial candidate preserves provisional NO and identifies the actual earlier-cessation question instead of using the 1982 cleanup date. The entire official extract of EO12095 identifies the Wien Air Alaska/Air Line Pilots Association dispute and contains two numbered provisions: a three-member investigative board with a member-disqualification rule, and a report within30days. Three exact spans preserve these distinct commands. The complete actor EO12379 section5 revokes EO12095; its present-tense command, no deferred effective provision elsewhere, and dated heading/tail support August17,1982 as a formal revocation event only. Original and actor PDF hashes match GPO fixity rows, and neither extract has a material identity, operative-boundary, or completeness ambiguity; no page-image verification is claimed. Actual investigative/report completion and the statutes expressly invoked are required before finding first end or closing residual effects. No termination date is computed from the deadline. The OFR and eCFR machine scopes were judged suitable as bounded later-reference searches after rejecting the corrupted cross-actor chains; they do not establish the historical report event.
